 Published on November 16, 2026 by Choose Chicago 
 Want to know what’s happening this weekend in Chicago? Look no further. There’s a whole calendar of exciting events , exhibits, and activities taking place all over the city this month in Chicago .
 Highlights this weekend include:
 The 113th Annual City of Chicago Tree Lighting Ceremony in Millennium Park on Friday
 The Wintrust Magnificent Mile Lights Festival parade and fireworks this Saturday on Michigan Avenue
 The opening weekend of Christkindlmarket Chicago in Daley Plaza
 Top holiday light shows , like Lightscape and ZooLights 
 Check out just a few of the events and happening in Chicago this weekend, Nov. 20 – 22, 2026.
 Nov 20 113th Annual City of Chicago Tree Lighting Ceremony 
 Chicago will officially kick off the holiday season with its 113th Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony in Millennium Park. Join Mayor Brandon Johnson, DCASE Commissioner Kenya…
 Loop

201 E. Randolph St. Nov 21 The Wintrust Magnificent Mile Lights Festival 
 The annual winter celebration, a local tradition for more than 30 years, marks the beginning of the holiday season in Chicago with an all-day holiday extravaganza.
 The grand tree-lighting parade on Saturday evening finishes with a stunning fireworks display over the Chicago River .
 Event details Saturday November 21, 2026 Michigan Avenue
